Frequently Asked Questions

Does RRU replace human real estate agents?

No. RRU captures and structures prospect-provided information into actionable briefings. It assists human professionals and does not make final business or real estate decisions.

How fast can our brokerage deploy this?

Targeted deployment is within 72 hours following receipt of required onboarding information and business configuration details.
